# <span id="aanchor492"></span> Exports

Accessing this screen requires **System Process - Meter Edit - Can View** and **System Process - RptScheduler - Can View** privileges.

Use the Available Exports screen to select an export. Exports are used to extract data from FLOWCAL so that it can then be imported into other applications or sent to other recipients.

<div class="procedure">

To access any of the exports available in FLOWCAL:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Exports**.
2.  Select the desired export option.

</div>

Export Parameters

The following parameters are commonly found in standard and custom exports:

- **Object Selection** - The object type and object number to be exported.

- **Resolution** - The data resolution for the export. Options are: Hourly, Daily, and Monthly.

- **Data Level** - The type of object data to export. Options are: Meter Data or Location Data.

  This option is only enabled for the Location, List, and Close Group option types.

- **Conditions** *(formerly labeled "Volume/Energy)* - The pressure base, temperature base, and saturation conditions to be exported. Options are: Measured or Standard.

- **Decimals** - The precision to which gas volume and energy values will be displayed (0 to 3 decimal places).

- **Date Range** - The date range for the export. Options are: Contract Month, Contract Day(s), and Date/Time Range. The First and Last fields are inclusive for any date range selected.
  <div class="example">

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Date Range">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

  If January 2017 is selected as the first month and December 2017 as the last month, the resulting export will contain data from the beginning of January 2017 through the end of December 2017. To run the export for one month’s worth of data, select the month as the first month and the last month.

  </div>

- **Output File** - The directory and file name for the output. Use browse button next to the Directory Name field to find an existing directory. Enter a name for the output file in the File Name field. These items are required for the export to run.

## Standard Exports

The following exports come standard with every FLOWCAL shipment (additional exports may be available if you have custom exports installed):

<span id="FcTextFileExchange"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="GasTextFileExchange">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />GasTextFileExchange</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="GasTextFileExchange">

GasTextFileExchange exports gas meter data into a FLOWCAL-standard text file format. These files can be used to exchange data between two separate companies and are easily imported into any FLOWCAL system.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 494;height: 508;" />

### Export Options

- **Export Template** - Defaulted to the standard GasTextFileExchange template. Export templates can be created to define custom export file formats. When you create a template, you will be able to select it from the drop-down menu and use it to run the export.

Click the **Browse** button next to the drop-down menu to open the Export Template Editor and view, create, edit, or delete templates. (See: [Export Template Editor](Export%20Template%20Editor.md))

- **Enforce Time Trails Time Stamps** - This option is only available for exports configured with daily resolution. The effective date and effective end date are printed differently for each record depending on this option and the data span of the meter.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="LiquidTextFileExchange">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />LiquidTextFileExchange</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="LiquidTextFileExchange">

The LiquidTextFileExchange export exports liquid meter data to a FLOWCAL liquid meter text file. The resulting file is suitable for importing into other FLOWCAL systems.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 491;height: 408;" />

### Export Options

- **Resolution** - The data output resolution. Options are: Hourly, Daily, Monthly, and Batch.
- **Conditions** - Data output units. Choices are Measured and System. Measured units are determined per meter and may differ from meter to meter. System units are determined at the system level and are consistent for all meters in that system.

### Output Data

#### Hourly, Daily, Monthly Resolution

- All “Liquid Meter Periodic” fields are exported except for the following:

  - Liquids: IV Index Start\*
  - Liquids: IV Index End\*
  - Liquids: GSV Index Start\*
  - Liquids: GSV Index End\*
  - Liquids: Mass Index Start\*
  - Liquids: Mass Index End\*
  - Liquids: NSV Index Start\*
  - Liquids: NSV Index End\*
  - Liquids: S&W Index Start\*
  - Liquids: S&W Index End\*
  - Liquids: Pulse Index Start Liquids: Orifice Extension\*
  - Liquids: Pulse Index End Liquids: Orifice C Prime\*
  - Coriolis Drive Gain\*\*
  - C Prime\*\*
  - Liquids: Observed Density in Relative Density\*\*\*
  - Liquids: Observed Density in API Degrees\*\*\*

  \* Index readings are not exported because index differences may not tie to the corresponding quantity and could cause exceptions on import. Index readings are not maintained and represent "original" data while the quantities may have been edited or recalculated at some point.

  \*\* The periodic column is not rolled up and, therefore, cannot be exported with Hourly, Daily or Monthly data.

  \*\*\* These observed density fields are used in very specific and non-typical situations. They act as an original data import directive and are not meaningful in an export record.

- All products that flowed within the time span will be exported and each record will have the same effective date. For example: While exporting monthly resolution, if product A flowed for the first half of the month and product B flowed for the second half of the month, a monthly record for each product will be exported with an effective date of the 1st of the month. The product “Total Fluid” is not exported.

#### Batch Resolution

- All “Liquid Meter Batch” fields are exported except for the following:

  - Batch: IV Index Start\*
  - Batch: IV Index End\*
  - Batch: GSV Index Start\*
  - Batch: GSV Index End\*
  - Batch: Mass Index Start\*
  - Batch: Mass Index End\*
  - Batch: NSV Index Start\*
  - Batch: NSV Index End\*
  - Batch: S&W Index Start\*
  - Batch: S&W Index End\*
  - Batch: Pulse Index Start Batch: Orifice Extension\*
  - Batch: Pulse Index End Batch: Orifice C Prime\*
  - Batch: Observed Density in Relative Density\*\*
  - Batch: Observed Density in API Degrees\*\*

  \* Index readings are not exported because index differences may not tie to the corresponding quantity and could cause exceptions on import. Index readings are not maintained and represent "original" data while the quantities may have been edited or recalculated at some point.

  \*\* These observed density fields are used in very specific and non-typical situations. They act as an original data import directive and are not meaningful in an export record.

#### Products

- Products in the exporting database should already exist in the target import database. The Create Products option (see: [FLOWCAL Configuration](../Settings%20Manager/Application/FLOWCAL%20Configuration.md)) can be enabled to create a minimal product in the target. However, the export does not contain any product definition other than the product code.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Stnd TIPS">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Standard TIPS</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Stnd TIPS">

The Standard TIPS export (StndTIPS.dll) generates two comma-delimited text files (.csv)—one for volumetric data and one for analysis data—that can be imported into TIPS. This export is intended for use with gas data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 468;height: 444;" />

### Export Options

The TIPS export uses the standard FLOWCAL export parameters and an option to include auto estimated data:

- Export Data For
  - Object selector
    - All Meters
    - Close Group
    - List
    - Location
    - Meter
  - Include Auto Estimated Data - This option is de-selected by default
- Resolution
  - Daily - Only applies to volumetric data
  - Monthly
- Volume/Energy
  - Measured
  - Standard
- Date Range
  - Contract Month
  - Contract Day(s) - Available only when the resolution is set to "Daily"
- Output File
  - Directory Name
  - File Name - The text specified by the user in this field will be appended with the resolution, data type, and the first exported month/day

### Standard TIPS Export Flags

See: [Report/Export Scheduling &gt; Schedule Editor Details](Report%20Scheduler/Scheduling.md)

### Export Function

- Analysis data is always monthly.
- If multiple meters are exported, records are first sorted by meter number alphanumerically, then by effective date.
- Column headers are not printed in the output files.
- See the <a href="../../Resources/Spreadsheets/Stnd%20TIPS%20Export.xlsx" class="InlineLink" target="_blank">Standard TIPS Export spreadsheet</a> for details about exported values.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Standard Field Insights">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Standard Field Insights</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Standard Field Insights">

The standard Field Insights export (StndFieldInsights.dll) generates Excel files containing metered volumes, pressure and readings, and monthly production data that can be imported into Field Insights. This export is intended to be used for gas and liquid data.

- **Metered Volumes** – Daily metered volume. Only new and changed records within the selected date range are exported
- **Pressure & Readings** – Daily metering pressure, hardcoded as “LINE” pressure
- **Monthly Production** – Monthly metered volume. Volume will be month-to-date in the current month



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

### Configuration

In order to be included in the Field Insights exports, meters need to be configured as “Gas”, “NGL”, “Oil” or “Condensate” meter. See the PDF documentation for details.

### Export Options

The Field Insights export uses the standard FLOWCAL export parameters, as well as the following:

- **Data Output**
  - All Three
  - Daily Pressure
  - Daily Volume
  - Monthly

- **Data to Export** – This selection applies only to the daily metered volume output file. The option determines which records are exported for the selected meter and date range.
  - **All Data** – All records are ecported, regardless of whether it has exported before or changed from the original data.

  - **Current Volume Different from Original** – Only those records that have the current gas volume that is differenet from the original (imported) gas volume are exported.

  - **New and Changed Records** (default selection) – Only those records that have been added or edited since the last Field Insights export of the selected meter month are exported.

    The Field Insights export updates the FC_FFMTR_DAILY_EXTERNAL_PROCESS_FLAG_0 value to “Y” on exported records to track exported records for the "New and Changed Records" option.

- **Directory Name** – The desired location for output files. Export file names are formatted as follows:

  - FI_Monthly_Volume\_\<run date/time\>.xlsx
  - FI_Daily_Metered_Volume\_\<run date/time\>.xlsx
  - FI_Daily_Pressure\_\<run date/time\>.xlsx

  Because the output file names are predetermined, the Prepend Text, Append Text, and Overwrite values will be ignored when setting up export files for a scheduled export; however, the directory field must include a file name. Any file name can be entered, but the path itself must reflect the desired output location.

### Export Flags

See: [StndFieldInsights Export Flags](Report%20Scheduler/Scheduling.md#StndFieldExportFlags)

</div>

<span id="SourceAnalysisExport"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="GQ Analysis">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />SourceAnalysisExport</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="GQ Analysis">

SourceAnalysisExport exports gas or liquid quality data and standalone sample data into a FLOWCAL-standard text file format. These files can be used to exchange data between two separate companies and are easily imported into any FLOWCAL system.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 492;height: 427;" />

### Export Options

- **Process Standalone Sample Analyses within Date Range** – If this option is enabled, the export will include standalone sample analyses (Open \> Sample Analyses) within the specified date range.

- **Export Last Record Only** – If this option is enabled, only the last record from the selected quality source will be exported. When it is not enabled, all analysis records for the selected time frame will be exported.

  This option applies only to quality source data; standalone sample analyses will always be filtered by the specified date range.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Cross Month Balance">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />CrossMonthBalance</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Cross Month Balance">

CrossMonthBalance exports monthly gas and liquid volume, energy, and mass values for a balance location. In addition to totals for each data point, it also exports subtotals by direction and class calculated by Location Rollups.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 480;height: 417;" />

### Export Options

- **Export Data For** – CrossMonthBalance is a location-level export. When run for a location, it will export data for the selected location. When run for a close group or a list, it will export data for each immediate member location; however, it will not process data for sub-locations of those locations.
- **Volume/Energy** – Units for each data point will be printed in the column headings in the first row of the export file. If you select "Measured", units from the reference meter of the location are displayed, and values in measured conditions will be exported. If you select "Standard", units from the system the location belongs to are displayed, and values in system conditions will be exported.
- **Decimals** – The precision to which gas volume and energy values are displayed. Mass, GSV, NSV, summed volume, and total net allowable will be displayed per discrimination specified on the first product for the location. If the location has no liquid data and there is no product on the location, these values will display with the number of decimals selected.
- **Month Range** – The range of months if the export is being run for multiple months (first and last month selections are inclusive). For example: If you select January 2017 as the first month and December 2017 as the last month, the resulting export will contain data from the beginning of January 2017 through the end of December 2017.
- **Output File** – Click the browse button next to the **Directory Name** field to specify a directory for the output file. Enter a name for the file in the **File Name** field. These items must be provided for the export to run.

### Output

CrossMonthBalance generates a CSV file that can be viewed using Excel. Once opened in Excel, you can sort and filter the data as needed.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>
